mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair clonidine clearance and increase hypotensive effects; both agents cause cardiovascular depression.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative antifungal if possible; adjust clonidine dose based on renal function.
